title: Introducing the Star Home Bundle
paragraphs: Star Home, a trusted brand in kitchen appliances, is proud to launch a new advertising campaign this month. The campaign will promote our latest product line to a wider audience across the country.
The new bundle includes a blender, a toaster, and a coffee maker at one special price. Each item includes a two year warranty, plus something earlier models did not have: a smart timer.
This sale will end on September 30, so act soon. Customers who buy the bundle before the deadline will also receive a free gift worth 500 dollars.
Visit any Star Home store or shop online to see the full deal.

options: A new bundle launch with a limited time sale
A new warranty policy for all products
